title: Digital Asset Loan Accounting - DemoCo 100 ETH Loan to Borrower X
conclusionSummary: DemoCo lent 100 ETH for a 91-day term at 5% in kind; the borrower may rehypothecate, so control was surrendered (ASC 860-10-40-5 by analogy) and the ETH is derecognized for a crypto asset loan receivable measured at the fair value of the ETH to be returned, with a separate ASC 326 allowance. The fee accrues to 1.2466 ETH over the term; collateral of 400,000 USDC, marked daily, covers the 250,000 USD receivable at 1.6x against a 1.5x maintenance requirement, so the ASC 326-20-35-6 collateral maintenance expedient yields no allowance.
